desc:
🗺️ Welcome to Find The One Piece! 🏴‍☠️

Hop on for an adventure like no other! ⛵
Travel through the dangerous and wacky world of Pirates! 🏝️
If you enjoy this game please Like and Favorite to support us! 👍⭐

🖱️ Controls:
Space / Jump to Double Jump
Q / ButtonB to Dash

⚜️ Rebirths Unlock:
• ⚡ Speed Multipliers
• 🚀 Jump Multipliers
• 🔥 Random Auras
• 🏷️ New Titles
• 🧍 Random Companions

🎮 Play with Friends!
Team up or go solo to search for Pirates, solve puzzles, and unlock hidden secrets across the map.

🏆 Current Number of Pirates to Find: 504
